initial_conditions: The saved Harbor revision 23 on the Apple Silicon studio, default orbit and both patterns framed.
actions: Open Harbor revision 23, use Frame all and capture the startup orbit.
Choose Front view in View and capture the workspace.
Open Command search with Command-K. Scroll the full list and check that its query stays visible. Type Top view.
Check the compact single result, use Tab and Return, then capture the Top view.
Export GLB while Top view is active. Restore Default orbit view and capture the same workspace.
Hide Harbor front in Scene and use Show all to restore both pieces.
expected_outcomes: Front and Top change only 3D canvas pixels. Default orbit restores the whole workspace PNG. Search results scroll separately from the query. The editable project and GLB retain their bytes.
